full/agent/odd: native.opencode key "bad key" cannot be written as frontmatter
full/hook/1: opencode runs session.start hooks only for a new session (source "startup"), which this hook does not match
full/hook/6: opencode has no hook when a session ends
full/hook/7: opencode has no hook when a subagent stops
full/hook/8: opencode runs hook commands through sh, which would expand the literal $ in argument "^a$"
full/native-hook/3: opencode has no native hook event "Notification" (use tool.execute.before, tool.execute.after or session.prompt)
full/skill/odd: native.opencode key "bad key" cannot be written as frontmatter
